scripts.check:bindings: rm -rf src/bindings && npm run bindings && git diff --exit-code src/bindings && ! grep -rq bigint src/bindings
scripts.dev: npm run build && vite build --watch --emptyOutDir false
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run build:ext
scripts.build:ext: vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode hook && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode relay
